title_en: The Singapore Food Deal Survival Guide
title_zh: 新加坡美食薅羊毛生存指南
excerpt_en: Singapore is expensive — but eating well doesn't have to be. From $3 chicken rice at hawker centres to 1-for-1 Starbucks happy hours, this is the complete playbook for eating great in Singapore without emptying your wallet.
excerpt_zh: 新加坡物价高——但吃得好不一定要花大钱。从食阁 $3 的海南鸡饭到 Starbucks 买一送一 Happy Hour，这是在新加坡吃得又好又省的完整攻略。
